topics.label: Lecture introduction and framing
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture topic and sets expectations regarding complement complexity.

topics.label: Complement fundamentals and C3 activation
topics.groupedBecause: They establish the general architecture, nomenclature conventions, and central C3 activation step of the complement system.

topics.label: Complement activation pathways
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how upstream recognition pathways generate convertases to reach the activation threshold.

topics.label: Complement effector mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: They describe the downstream functional outcomes through which activated complement eliminates pathogens and recruits immune responses.

topics.label: Regulation of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: It explains the host regulatory mechanisms that prevent complement activation from damaging host cells.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: It details the distinct clinical presentations and disease susceptibilities caused by deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: It describes the evolutionary mechanisms and molecular strategies used by pathogens to subvert complement defenses.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture on complement and previews the upcoming session on the adaptive immune system.
